# ghost_gitignore_templates (Data Source)

Lists the `.gitignore` templates Ghost offers, the values `ghost_repository`'s `gitignore_template` takes, and optionally reads one template's content with `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every .gitignore template name, the values ghost_repository's
# gitignore_template takes.
data "ghost_gitignore_templates" "all" {}

# One template and its content. Names are matched case-insensitively:
# template.name is Ghost's spelling, "Go".
data "ghost_gitignore_templates" "go" {
  name = "go"
}

resource "ghost_repository" "example" {
  name               = "example"
  auto_init          = true
  gitignore_template = data.ghost_gitignore_templates.go.template.name
}

output "go_gitignore" {
  value = data.ghost_gitignore_templates.go.template.source
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) A template to read into `template`, e.g. `Go`. Ghost matches it case-insensitively (`go` finds `Go`). Omit it to only list the names.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `gitignore_templates`.
- `names` (List of String) The name of every template, in Ghost's order (sorted byte-wise, so upper case comes first, e.g. `Zig` before `bun`).
- `template` (Attributes) The template named by `name`; null when `name` isn't set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--template))

<a id="nestedatt--template"></a>
### Nested Schema for `template`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Ghost's spelling of the template's name, which may differ in case from `name`.
- `source` (String) The template's content: exactly the `.gitignore` a repository created with this `gitignore_template` (and `auto_init`) starts with.
